title: Achievement counter
description: Shows a player board and lets you view any player's advancements.
body:
This mod for viewing an achievements of all players in the server. To view the open leaderboard you have to press Y and after that you can select the player which achievements you want to select. To select them you have to hover mouse on them and press Y to view achievements. H to hide/unhide the HUD display of the leaderboard. When you pressed the Y on the player there's gonna be a menu that shows completed or not done achievements. So this mod also follows the icon of any achievement the name of it and the description of it.

Note: To refresh the info about the achievements they own in the leaderboard you have to press Y(which opens leaderboard). You also can press esc to close the menus.
Now to work this mod you have to be installed the fabric api.
This mod will work with any data pack that has achivements inside it and normal minecraft achievements.
